cc:Work.dc:title: Annualised costs, 2024–2050
cc:Work.dc:description: Global annualised (a) whole-system and (b) sector costs, in constant 2010 USD. The system axis uses trillions and the sector axis billions; costs are not stacked or interpreted as an exhaustive system breakdown. The main report shows 2024–2050 to keep later trends legible. Initial-year cost anomalies are not corrected or discarded: the full-period series appear in Figure S2 and the audit identifies negative regional costs. Source cost accounting needs checking before substantive interpretation.
